lines: In this demo, Sentry holds the company policy as three rules.
The first rule: personal data, sent to an untrusted external destination. Its suggested enforcement is block.
The second says the same for health data, and the third for restricted data.
Untrusted means outside the organization. The cluster's own services count as inside. Here the contracted courier runs as one of them.
So does any address on a list the company sets.
The forecaster's address is on neither: external, and untrusted.
Sentry evaluates the rules with O P A, the Open Policy Agent. Here are the first rule's conditions, as Sentry shows them.
Any flow that carries personal data to a destination that is external and untrusted fires the rule.
